name: After § 43
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union agencies for the financial year 2024
part_text: 43 a. Rejects the request of the European Union Agency for Fundamental Rights for additional funding; stresses that the FRA should carry out its mandate with neutrality and transparency; calls for an end to its persistent attempts to interfere in the activities of institutions and agencies, in particular those already having internal staff responsible for fundamental rights; invites consideration of terminating the mandate of the Agency, given that it overlaps with the services of several other agencies, thereby limiting its added value;
